production.note: US model years 2017 to 2019. First: the spec sheet is headed "2017 Porsche Models Technical Data" with a "911 Carrera S" column ("Boxer, twin-turbo"). Last: Kelley Blue Book's 2019 911 page lists the Carrera S with "420 horsepower @ 6,500 rpm" and a "3.0-liter twin-turbocharged flat-6", and notes that "the all-new 2020 911" (992) follows (kbb-2019-911).

body.note: Columns '911 Carrera S' (coupe) and '911 Carrera S Cabriolet'.

displacementL.note: The sheet prints 'Displacement (Liters) 3.0 l' for the Carrera S coupe and no cc figure (the Carrera S Cabriolet column reads '3.8 l', evidently a misprint: the PCNA press information says the Carrera S makes 420 hp "operating with the same displacement" as the three-liter Carrera, pcna-2017-911-press-info). Porsche's US Carrera T sheet gives 2,981 cm³ for the 370 hp version of this 3.0-liter engine (pcna-911-carrera-t-specs).

fuel.note: Inferred from the sheet's description of a twin-turbo boxer engine; no hybrid system is described.

drivetrain.note: 'Drivetrain Rear-wheel drive'. The all-wheel-drive Carrera 4S is a different model.

transmission.note: 'Transmission type 7-speed manual / 7-speed PDK'. DCT is Porsche PDK.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maximum power output @ engine speed 370 hp @ 6500 420 hp @ 6500 370 hp @ 6500 420 hp @ 6500" (911 Carrera | 911 Carrera S | 911 Carrera Cabriolet | 911 Carrera S Cabriolet). PCNA press information: "Operating with the same displacement, the 911 Carrera S makes 420 hp." Still 420 hp for 2019 per kbb-2019-911.

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 7-speed manual, 2017 model. Quote: "Curb weight (lbs) 3153 lbs. (man.) / 3197 lbs. (PDK) 3175 lbs. (man.) / 3219 lbs. (PDK) 3307 lbs. (man.) / 3351 lbs. (PDK) 3329 lbs. (man.) / 3373 lbs. (PDK)" (911 Carrera | 911 Carrera S | 911 Carrera Cabriolet | 911 Carrera S Cabriolet). PDK coupe 3,219 lb; Cabriolet 3,329 lb manual.

sources.publisher: Porsche Cars North America (Porsche Newsroom USA)
